card.text: A Cepheid in the Large Magellanic Cloud, 73 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 14.2 days.

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 72.7 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 45,859 parsecs away.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
